answer: A verifier detects clone farms in three steps. It lists accounts funded from one source within 48 hours, places them in the orchard review pool, and replays 1 in 8 of their tasks. Each extra clone in a group raises the timber-tier deposit by 10 POA, so 6 clones cost 10+20+30+40+50+60 = 210 POA while one honest account pays 10. Flags go in a public umber log, and a wrongly flagged user appeals within 5 epochs to get the deposit back.
